title: rpt evidence record
description: One reference a finding makes to an evidence file, from its evidence list or a link in its body, as rpt evidence emits it; with --orphans, also each file under findings/evidence/ that nothing references, which has no finding, ref or source. Schema version 2.

finding.description: ID of the finding that makes the reference.

ref.description: The path as the finding writes it, relative to the finding file.

source.description: frontmatter: the evidence list; body: an image or link in a section.

path.description: Relative to the report root. Absent when ref leaves the report.

file.description: Absolute path, symlinks not resolved; use it to open the file. Absent when ref leaves the report.

rev.description: The referencing finding's revision; an evidence file's own bytes aren't tracked. Opaque: compare it, never compute it. Pass it back as --if-rev so a write is refused if the finding changed since this read.
